nodes.applies_when: Validate the requested operation and route Search or HDL Create, Update, End Date or Zap. Correct, account-only Delete and Delete (ED Split) remain unsupported.
Search: validate environment selection and supplied filter shapes; omitted optional filters continue to Search defaulting.
Search: apply only Search defaults and normalize costing-state labels using the lookup wire mapping; do not apply HDL account defaults.
Search: call resolve_costing_ldg only for requested LDG names, IDs, flex context, or candidates; otherwise return skipped without a call. Return listed only for an LDG-only result scope.
Search: call list_payroll_period_types only for a requested period type or choice list; otherwise return skipped without a call. Return listed only for a period-type-list-only result scope.
Search: call search_payroll_costing with all resolved filters; found or empty requires complete pagination.
Search completed with found or empty results and complete pagination; return mapped rows, applied filters, and the effective date.
The user requested LDG choices/context only; return complete LDG results with their associated flex values and no payroll search.
The user requested period-type choices only; return complete code/label choices and no payroll search.
Validate operation-specific selectors and dates before reads. End Date requires a target start and separate inclusive end, not account input.
Create only: resolve the canonical LDG and flex, then the payroll definition and HDL identity.
Create only: require zero active Generic Costing parents for PAY, PayrollId, LDG, and the requested start date.
Create only: retrieve the runtime descriptor for the selected LDG flex.
Create only: validate the supplied account components using the runtime descriptor and its declared LOV contracts.
Update only: resolve canonical payroll/LDG/flex, complete PAY history and the matching current parent/account baseline using the Update lookup rules.
Resolve the current runtime descriptor for the Update LDG flex.
Build the complete expected distribution with only explicit COST segment changes and validate all populated values at the new effective date.

Apply operation-scoped defaults only after that branch has resolved identity, current state, KFF and segment validation. Create requires its four lookup nodes; Update requires its three lookup nodes. Never apply the Create end-date default to Update.

Require operation-specific identity, state, KFF and segment facts. Create requires its four preceding lookup nodes; Update requires COP.UPDATE.RESOLVE_STATE, COP.UPDATE.RESOLVE_KFF and COP.UPDATE.VALIDATE_SEGMENTS. Approval remains deferred to the submission gate.
End Date only: resolve canonical payroll/LDG, complete history and the exact selected parent/accounts using the End Date lookup rules; skip KFF validation.
Validate the latest interval, explicit date bounds and complete baseline. Equal end is a verified no-op.
Set only PAY, canonical keys and ReplaceLastEffectiveEndDate=Y for the parent-only End Date contract; preserve both resolved dates.
The selected latest interval already ends on the requested date; report verified state with no load.

After Create lookups/defaults, the invoking runbook prepares both DAT members and the immutable ZIP through core.data-loader. Validate the Create DAT contract, loader schema, and Task Hook preview without submitting or requesting an earlier approval.
Enforce the verified Update DAT contract, exact immutable expectation, live loader schema and Task Hook preview before approval.
Validate the exact parent-only DAT and immutable archive through core.data-loader and Task Hook; preserve the special date-effectivity attribute.
Before handoff, require the applicable successful source-validation node and all branch-specific lookup facts. Create uses COP.CREATE.VALIDATE_SOURCE; Update uses COP.UPDATE.VALIDATE_SOURCE.
Enforce parent-only End Date scope, preserved history/accounts and exact loader-approved source. Approval is obtained only for this immutable archive.
Resolve canonical payroll/LDG and complete PAY history for the exact selector start; retain the entire selected logical allocation.
Invoke query_payroll_costing_history_accounts for every selected history key and retain complete physical child identities or explicit proof of no children.
Require one selector match, complete nonoverlapping logical history and exact detail coverage with consistent physical identities. No missing child set may be treated as empty.
Require canonical payroll/LDG identity and complete history/detail evidence; skip KFF dependencies. Archive approval remains deferred until execution.

Apply only SourceType PAY and resolved canonical keys. Preserve earliest history start, latest history end and all bound physical identities. No open-end default, percentage conversion, account sequence or SET instruction applies.

Validate the exact parent and conditional account DELETE members against the Zap contract and current core.data-loader DELETE/schema support. Prepare immutable archive and Task Hook preview; stop at actual validation failures.

Require complete logical history and exact account scope, loader-approved DELETE archive and successful Task Hook rules. Prepare the destructive preview before the single core.data-loader approval gate.

The exact Create archive passed source/schema and Task Hook validation, has current prerequisite evidence and core.data-loader approval, and is handed once to core.data-loader. No direct REST write or second approval flow is permitted.
Evaluate the exact submitted Create archive's Content ID, Request ID, and loader status; verification requires terminal success for both objects.
The same Create load is initiated or pending. Return its governed resume reference; a later authorized status check resumes COP.CREATE.RESULT for that handoff without resubmission.
Verify the exact parent and account expectations only after terminal success for both Create DAT members.
The exact Update archive passed source/schema and Task Hook validation, has fresh core.data-loader approval, and is submitted once through that service.
Evaluate the same accepted Update load. Resume on an explicit status or verification request; no automatic resubmission.
Return accepted initiation or pending status with the same loader reference. An explicit later status or verification request resumes COP.UPDATE.RESULT without re-submission.
Apply Update history and account comparisons to the immutable baseline and expectation after terminal loader success.
Submit the exact parent-only archive once through core.data-loader after source/schema and Task Hook success and fresh approval. No direct mutation route.
Return pending on accepted initiation; resume the same loader result only on explicit status or verification request, without resubmission.
Return the accepted or pending load reference without polling. An explicit later status or verification request resumes the same result.
Apply End Date history and inclusive-end/next-day account comparisons only after terminal success of the exact parent-only load.
Hand the exact validated Zap archive once to core.data-loader after its single current destructive approval and Task Hook envelope. No direct mutation route.
Create is verified through matching parent and account reads after terminal success for both loaded objects. Persist only redacted run and verification facts.

Accepted initiation is pending. On an explicit later status request require terminal success of the same Content ID/Request ID for every included object before verification. Never automatically replay a deletion.

Return accepted initiation or pending result with saved complete history/account scope and loader reference. Resume only on an explicit status/verification request; do not poll or resubmit automatically.
Verify saved logical history and every historical start are absent only after terminal success of the same Zap load; never rediscover the deleted selector as a prerequisite.
Update is verified: prior history/accounts preserved and the new interval matches the approved change and full carried-forward distribution.
End Date verified: only the latest end changed, prior history and accounts are unchanged, and the parent is absent the following day.
Zap verified: the selected logical allocation is absent from complete history and every saved historical start returns zero parents and accounts.
Any validation, dependency, design, approval, loader, artifact, or unsupported-operation failure.
The request stopped with a classified diagnostic and safe next action.
